$comment: The theme registry. Qeetrix themes are BUILD-TIME artifacts, not runtime objects: a theme is a directory of token overrides under src/tokens/theme/<name>/ plus one entry here that says which CSS selector its variables are published under. Registering a theme is what makes scripts/build/tokens.mjs emit it and what makes the token-governance test check it (parity, types, cycles, contrast) — both read this file, and both fail if a src/tokens/theme/* directory has no entry or an entry has no directory. The first entry is the parity BASE: every other theme is checked against it, so a colour it omits is reported rather than silently inherited. Selectors are written here rather than derived because a brand theme's selector is a cascade decision (specificity against `.dark`) that only the person adding it can make; see docs/standards/theming.md.

themes.name: light
themes.description: The base theme. Its selector is :root, so it is what renders when no theme class or attribute is present, and it is the parity base every other theme is compared against.

themes.name: dark
themes.description: The dark colour scheme, switched by the .dark class that ThemeProvider toggles on <html>.
